debit.notes: 24X7 hotline (bank's help-and-support page: "Get 24X7 assistance at our customer service hotline" on 1800 23400). Debit-card policy: block the card on the Airtel Thanks app or call 1800-23400, the bank's call-centre number for hotlisting the debit card; no SMS block format and no netbanking block path are published on the bank's pages. 18002033330 is the bank's Report-a-Fraud contact number (contact-us), alongside fraud.reporting@airtelbank.com and the online fraud-reporting form at https://i.airtel.in/AIRBNK/fraudreporting-web; the contact-us page also points to the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in. Card range is debit/prepaid only (RuPay ON-THE-GO NCMC, debit, Insta EMI, virtual) — the bank issues no credit card, so no credit section is included.

upi.notes: UPI freeze is SMS-based, per the bank's own UPI FAQ (frequently-asked-questions, UPI tab): "Customers need to send “Disable” to 9205832352 from their registered mobile number to disable UPI services on Airtel Payments Bank account"; for the savings account, "send an SMS "Disable UPI" to 50400" — re-enable later with SMS "Enable UPI" to 50400. No netbanking UPI manage path, no USSD *99# and no dedicated in-app UPI-lock menu are published on the bank's pages. For UPI complaints the FAQ says "You have the option to either call us or raise a complaint within the mobile application itself. In Airtel Thanks app, you can navigate to "More" and click on "Help and Support""; lost-phone guidance is "please contact our customer support at your bank". 1800-23400 is the FAQ footer's "Dial for all queries: 1800-23400 (toll free)" line; fraud-specific contact remains 18002033330 (contact-us).
